title: My Top 3 AI-Assisted Games You NEED to Try!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
I have been getting this question so many times lately, as one of the founders of VibeTopList.com.

Here are my personal top 3 right now:

1. Azeroth Survivors, a Warcraft fan-made game. Very simple but yet addictive concept. Basically World of Warcraft x Vampire Survivors. To my surprise, the game is pretty in-depth as well. You can customise your character, obtain gear pieces, fight known WoW bosses, etc. As an AI game enthusiast, you should definitely try this one out if you haven't already. It was one of our first submissions and is now one of the most popular vibe-coded projects out there.
2. Aurelia Legends, a Pokémon-inspired browser MMO that brings the Pokémon experience into an online multiplayer world. Explore, collect, and battle. This is the type of Pokémon experience I personally always wanted, and it's been a blast. Somehow, Nintendo never thought about this, which is extremely odd in my opinion.
3. Grim Reach Idle, an idle RPG for players who love character progression, grinding, and watching their characters grow stronger over time. Perfect if you enjoy incremental games where there's always another upgrade or milestone to work toward. What makes this game special to me is the depth. This game is your typical AI-assisted game, made with care.

If my personal top 3 isn't enough, I can do a top 5 or top 10 next time because, honestly, there are so many fun vibe-coded games to be played right now.
